headline: Large User Grid Cost Responsibility
short_summary: This bill directs Dominion Energy Virginia to propose cost allocation for large industrial customers, including data centers, to ensure they bear more of the grid infrastructure costs, thereby protecting other ratepayers.
status: Last Action: Acts of Assembly Chapter text (CHAP1123) on 2026-05-14
opponents: Data center industry, large industrial users.
news_headline: Virginia Bill Aims to Cut Residential Energy Costs.
news_summary: A Virginia bill, HB 1393 (and similar SB 253), aims to shift energy-related expenses, such as power purchased through regional auctions and infrastructure like substations, onto data centers and large industrial users. This cost shift is projected to save the average residential customer more than $5.50 a month.

headline: Data Center Water Use Transparency
short_summary: This bill requires local water authorities to report data center water usage to the State Water Control Board, making this information publicly available to enhance transparency and oversight.
status: Last Action: Acts of Assembly Chapter text (CHAP0896) on 2026-04-13
supporters: Environmental groups, local communities, transparency advocates.
news_headline: New Virginia law requires data center water usage be public.
news_summary: A new Virginia law, SB 553, mandates that local water authorities report data center water usage, which will be aggregated and made available on the Department of Environmental Quality's website. This aims to provide clearer insight into local resource use, addressing concerns about the industry's water consumption.

headline: Data Center Siting and Noise Regulations
short_summary: This bill introduces new siting requirements for large data centers, mandating impact assessments and addressing noise concerns through local ordinances and mitigation methods.
status: Last Action: Incorporated by Counties, Cities and Towns (HB153-Thomas) (Voice Vote) on 2026-01-23
supporters: Local communities, residents near proposed data centers, environmental groups.
news_headline: Virginia adds new restrictions on data centers.
news_summary: HB 153, along with other bills, introduces new siting requirements for large data centers, mandating impact assessments on agriculture, parks, and historical sites before rezoning approval. It also addresses growing concerns about data center noise, with local governments exploring legislative avenues and revising ordinances to mitigate the issue.
